historical_reviews.deepseek: It selects a read-only command but leaves source-entity coverage, target attribution, credential safety and the example mismatch unresolved.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly keeps full automation and restores exact raw/entity fidelity with field-level thermal evidence.
historical_reviews.history: The invalidated prior-run location was searched and excluded as authority; the baselined IB sibling and next Redfish boundary were compared only for route and function separation.
historical_reviews.v3_1: A temperature byte becomes valid evidence only after it is tied to the requested entity/instance, decoded with correct units/status and attributed to the intended remote controller.

original_test_intent: Read inlet, CPU and baseboard DCMI temperatures from the intended BMC over LANPlus, validate every requested entity/instance and preserve a time- and context-attributed thermal snapshot without changing policy.
original_method: Retain exact OOB raw 0x2c/0x10 requests for source entities 0x40, 0x41 and 0x42, adding secret-safe target/session binding, response decoding and inventory comparison.
manual_activity: The project provisions the approved endpoint/credential mechanism, thermal response schema, expected entity/instance inventory and operating-range context; the end user owns PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED.
required_inputs: BMC endpoint bound to immutable SUT identity
Approved cipher and secret-safe credential source
safety_requirements: Keep credentials out of argv and evidence
Fail closed on target/session or entity mismatch
No thermal-limit, fan, power, reset or workload action
agent_execution_scope: Capture time, workload and ambient context
Issue exact bounded request for each source entity
Validate completion, length, entity and instance
Decode units, status, thresholds and temperature
engineer_actions: Provide endpoint/access, decoder and fitted inventory
Approve operating ranges and review anomalies

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The high-level getter is supplemental, but its 0x44 example conflicts with the source's explicit 0x40-0x42 coverage and its `-P` form can expose secrets; it also does not prove the source raw request or all response fields.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After immutable target binding, use secret-safe LANPlus transport to issue raw 0x2c 0x10 0xdc 0x01 <entity> 0x01 0 once for each of 0x40, 0x41 and 0x42, decoding every response and recording unsupported instances.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source OOB route, opcode, three entity IDs and 10/5 timing remain; no 0x44 entity, instance count or temperature range is inferred.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Collect separately attributable raw and decoded temperature records for the three source entity groups through an identity-bound remote session, with common timing/load context and strict schema validation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds target/secret controls and a per-entity semantic oracle beyond command success.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: The baselined IB sibling cannot prove LANPlus behavior; the high-level 0x44 example does not cover the source entity map and must not replace it.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: CPU entity 0x41 may expose multiple instances; transient values, stale status or wrong scaling can appear plausible, and a wrong reachable BMC can return a believable thermal profile.

project_override_considerations: A Redfish/vendor thermal API is equivalent only when it proves the same three entity groups and instances with immutable target attribution; omitted LANPlus/raw coverage must be disclosed.
expected_evidence: Immutable SUT/BMC endpoint and redacted secret-safe session identity
Approved schema, decoder and expected entity/instance inventory
Per-entity exact raw request and complete response
Completion, length, entity/instance, units, scaling, status, thresholds and temperature
Timestamped workload/ambient context and inventory/range comparison
No secret leakage or thermal/power/fan/reset/configuration/log mutation

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master title, raw procedure and entity map consistently specify an OOB temperature read for 0x40-0x42. The success-only criterion is incomplete; DeepSeek's 0x44 example is an overlay defect, not a Master contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The route, command and source entities are explicit. Endpoint, secrets, decoder, inventory and expected ranges are standard readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Makes remote thermal readings source-faithful, target-attributable and validated per entity/instance while excluding the unapproved 0x44 example.
independent_technical_reasoning: The DeepSeek example is not a harmless placeholder because choosing entity 0x44 would test a different object than the source's inlet, CPU and baseboard map. Automation must execute and label each source entity independently, validate status and units before comparing temperatures, and bind the remote endpoint to hardware. This separates true sensor coverage from a successful but semantically different query.
